Plan SHA256: 0224854b40537bb5866a73a563e72428473e1ded2cfbd1f0a98b4ffc0b20979b

Classification: audit qualification follow-up, separate from the thirteen confirmed defects. Preserve the parent scientific-scope limits.

Action and paths
`R/RcppExports.R`, native kernel inputs in `src/row_ops.cpp`. Put durable validation in the native implementations or stable R wrappers, not hand-edits to files regenerated by Rcpp. Validate list length, each system matrix dimension, RHS shape, graph dimension, finite inputs, and valid grouping indices.

Acceptance evidence / regression tests
Malformed shapes/types yield R errors before Eigen indexing. Valid small kernels agree with explicit base-R row-system operations, Laplacian multiplication, and `rowsum()`. No deliberate crash test in the main R process.

Completion: record the tested source revision, precise regression names, retained receipts, and unresolved scientific assumptions. A smoke test does not establish calibration.
